leftEvidence.title: Speaking and mighty works do not replace being known

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus says not everyone calling him Lord enters the Kingdom, but the one doing his Father’s will does.
points.right: Jesus compares everyone hearing and doing his words to a wise builder on rock.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Claims of prophecy, exorcism, and mighty works meet the reply, “I never knew you.”
points.right: The same storm exposes the difference between a house that stands and one that falls.

payload.posture: Both closing sayings contrast verbal proximity to Jesus with action.

rightEvidence.title: Hearing and doing determine the foundation

payload.tension: Mighty works and a storm-tested foundation expose different ways that appearance can fail.
payload.title: Saying Lord and doing the words
